q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a vehicle radiator?
title: Radiator carbon footprint per unit
short: Weigh the aluminium or copper-brass core and the plastic or metal tanks per radiator and multiply by supplier figures. Add brazing or soldering, assembly and leak testing energy, then divide by radiators passed.
audience: Radiator makers and auto component suppliers

ul: Aluminium tubes and fins, or copper and brass.

p: Report per radiator by vehicle type and core material.

example.title: Worked example: radiator unit per unit (one month)
lines: Plant total: 38,650 / 20,000 = 1.933 kg CO2 per unit
Add metals and tanks for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
